name: @feldspar/schema
title: Schema editing
description: Let an application's code create and change tables — for an app whose users define their own — within a table-name prefix you choose.
supplies: An action, schema_apply: a batch of schema operations in the shape MCP edit_schema takes, applied in one transaction, or refused whole.
Convenience actions with Saltcorn 1 shaped arguments, each one operation: create_table, add_field, alter_field, rename_table, drop_field and drop_table.
Defaults for every table it creates (row history, read and write roles, row-level security), set in its settings so the application need not repeat them.

A table it creates is connected to the application whose custom query ran it; the row API is not opened. Run the actions from a trigger only an admin may run, from a custom query's trigger("…").asAdmin().run(…), after the query has checked who may.
